Chermside Motor Inn offers clean and spacious accommodation in the heart of Chermside. The motel is approximately 900m to Prince Charles Hospital and St Vincent’s Private Hospital and 8 Kms from Royal Brisbane and Women's Hospital. The Motel is located only 400 meters from Chermside Westfield Shopping Centre, 8kms from Brisbane City Centre and only 20 minutes from both International & Domestic Airports. Public transport to the RNA Showgrounds, Royal Brisbane & Women’s Hospital, Brisbane CBD and Fortitude Valley is at the doorstep this makes the property an ideal choice for medical and business stays. The Motel has Double Brick walls & Double-Glazed windows that cuts maximum noise to avoid any disruption in a good night’s sleep. ALDI, Noodle Box, Indian Restaurant, BWS, Japanese Take Away, Burger and Chips Shop and a Convenience Store right next door will take the hassle away from the guests to find essentials after arriving at the property. Prime Location Ideally situated near Westfield Chermside Shopping Center and within easy reach of Prince Charles and St. Vincent's Hospitals, the hotel offers convenient access to popular spots and essential services.
